item.title: Every DC Studios Movie and TV Show in Coming Through 2028 (and Beyond)
item.description: There are still some lingering projects left over from the pre-Gunn era of the DCU, including a new Matt Reeves-led Batman movie and the fate of Peacemaker , the series starring John Cena that spanned two eras of DC film and television — and left fans contending with a major cliffhanger.

item.title: How to get the DLC weapons in Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave
item.description: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave 's DLC weapons give your army a sizeable advantage, though they do come with a few drawbacks. Obtaining the weapons involves completing a new subquest, and each of the four playable Flame Lords gets a special weapon. There's a bit of timeline funkiness involved in getting those weapons to Part 2 or beyond if you've already completed someone's Part 1. It's worth the hassle, though.

item.title: GTA 6 Recaptures What Made GTA’s Best DLC So Great
item.description: If there’s one word that describes GTA 6 , it’s sexy . Since its debut trailer, the new open-world game appears to be a drastic detour from Rockstar’s previous entries, in its enhanced version of Vice City, and in the dynamic between its dual protagonists and how their steamy relationship informs the narrative. Based on roughly 30 minutes of official footage across its four main trailers, club life, excessive robberies, pastel pinks, roaring high-end sports cars, and even more explosive action set pieces than GTA 5 seem to be the hallmarks of this new experience. It’s shaping up to be Rockstar's magnum opus.

item.title: Street Fighter’s Best Live-Action Movie Yet Is Free on Streaming
item.description: The latest Street Fighter movie is out, and early reactions are not pretty. The film is currently sitting at 45% on Rotten Tomatoes and a 44 score on Metacritic. Polygon described it as an “incoherent, irredeemable mess” that flounders for an overlong two-hour runtime before ending in an anticlimax. While the action scenes are apparently solid, even they aren’t quite right, as these sequences underutilize the characters’ superhuman abilities. The main subject of praise has been David Dastmalchian’s deliciously campy performance as M. Bison.

item.title: Laura Bailey's Favorite Critical Role Romance Changed Campaign 3 Forever
item.description: Over the years, Critical Role has featured plenty of romances across its Dungeons & Dragons campaigns and one-shots. These include the angst-ridden yet sweet love between haughty noble Percival Del Rolo and strong-willed ranger Vex’ahlia in Campaign 1, and the intriguing will-they-won’t-they dynamic between warlock Fjord Stone and the bubbly tiefling cleric Jester in Campaign 2.

item.title: Game Freak Announces End of Beast of Reincarnation’s Post-Launch Updates
item.description: Beast of Reincarnation will stop receiving regular updates just over two months after its release. Developer Game Freak, best known as the studio behind Nintendo's Pokémon series, has announced the action RPG's current post-launch update plan is coming to an end. While this won't necessarily mean the end of support, it suggests the studio is ready to step away from Beast of Reincarnation and move on to other projects.

item.title: 2022’s Beloved Survival Adventure 'Stranded Deep' Is Free This Weekend
item.description: Released in Early Access in 2015, the survival crafting game Stranded Deep has built a strong following over the years, with over 20K Steam reviews alone. If you’re a fan of the genre and are looking for something to play this weekend, now might be a good time to give this one a try: it's free to play on Steam until 1 p.m. ET Oct. 19.

item.title: 7 Years Later, Apple’s Gaming Push Has Proven Surprisingly Resilient
item.description: The latest example of that came this week as Apple launched an App Store event dubbed Indie Games Week. The week-long initiative saw Apple welcoming games like Vampire Crawlers to iOS and announcing an ambitious mobile version of No Man’s Sky . At the center of that push was Carson Oliver, the new head of App Store Worldwide following Phil Schiller’s sudden departure from the role this past August. The fact that one of his first acts in the role was spearheading an indie gaming showcase hints at where Oliver’s priorities might lie.

item.title: 'GeoGuessr' Just Changed Genres With A Must-Play Upgrade
item.description: Browser-based deduction game GeoGuessr has been around for a long time, and most people are content to simply watch Trevor Rainbolt correctly identify a location within seconds. Yet the developers behind GeoGuessr just gave everyone a good reason to revisit the storied internet game.
